content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

A no-KYC payment gateway is a system that allows digital sellers to receive payments without requiring buyers to undergo Know Your Customer (KYC) verification. This is particularly important for sellers in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. By using a no-KYC payment gateway, sellers can expand their customer base and increase sales, ultimately retaining more of their hard-earned revenue. For instance, NOWPayments charges only 0.5% on every sale, whereas Gumroad charges 10%, resulting in a significant difference of $921 at 100 sales per month on a $97 product.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a no-KYC payment gateway typically involves a combination of free and paid tools, including hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and order storage solutions like Supabase or Google Sheets. Automated delivery is facilitated through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, while NOWPayments handles crypto payment processing, allowing for seamless transactions in over 300 cryptocurrencies. This infrastructure provides a robust and scalable foundation for digital commerce, enabling sellers to focus on creating and marketing their products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are restricted, such as Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and Bangladesh. These creators produce a wide range of digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and software, but often struggle to find reliable payment processing solutions. By providing a no-KYC payment gateway, we empower these creators to take control of their sales and revenue, without relying on intermediaries or sacrificing a significant portion of their earnings to platform fees.
No-KYC payment gateways empower digital creators to take control of their sales and revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this infrastructure include hosting, backend logic, order storage, automated delivery, and crypto payment processing. Each of these components plays a crucial role in ensuring a seamless and secure transaction experience for both sellers and buyers. For example, Cloudflare Pages provides fast and reliable hosting, while Supabase offers a scalable and secure order storage solution. By integrating these components, sellers can create a robust and efficient digital commerce stack that meets their specific needs and goals.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a no-KYC payment gateway today, sellers can start by selecting a hosting service and setting up their backend logic and order storage solutions. They can then integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing and configure automated delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), sellers can access all the necessary blueprints and templates to build, deploy, and scale their sovereign digital commerce stack, including instant download and lifetime access to the kit's resources.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5% on every sale. This solution allows you to receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, without requiring buyers to undergo KYC verification. To deploy a no-KYC payment gateway, start by selecting a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and configure your order storage solution with Supabase or Google Sheets. Then, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing and automate delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Finally, test and deploy your digital commerce stack, and start selling your digital products with a no-KYC payment gateway.
